title: Bossman Steward objective runtime state (V5)
description: Durable projection of one standing objective, as persisted by bossman_shared.objective_store. This record is bookkeeping, not authority: it is what admission re-reads to resolve current authority, and it is never itself proof about the world. Lifecycle and condition are independent axes; an ACTIVE objective whose condition is UNKNOWN must produce no effects.

condition.description: UNKNOWN is a real answer, never a placeholder for healthy or broken.

enrolled_sources.description: Explicit owner enrollment. Empty on import: no account or directory is ever enrolled implicitly, and an unenrolled source cannot affect the condition.

cost_usd_used.description: Cumulative across revisions, including reserved work. Editing the spec must never reset it.

last_verified_evidence_ref.description: Required whenever condition is SATISFIED: green is not settable by model text.

stopped.description: Canonical resolution of the owner's stop conditions, not a model's reading of them.

version.description: Compare-and-swap token. A mutation carrying a stale version is refused, never merged.
